pairs.target: sāntiān hòu , zhuōshàng zhēn duō le yíkuài xiàng xiǎo dùn de mùbǎn , tǎ wéi shēnshǒu qù ná , wéi lǎoshī què xiān jiào tā kàn xiàmiàn , mùbǎn gē zài huázuò shàng , bìng bùnéng jǔ zǒu .
pairs.english: Three days later, a shieldlike wooden board really had appeared on the table; Tavi reached to take it, but Instructor Vey first told him to look underneath: the board rested on a sliding seat and could not simply be lifted away.
pairs.hanzi: 三天后，桌上真多了一块像小盾的木板，塔维伸手去拿，维老师却先叫他看下面，木板搁在滑座上，并不能举走。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn bǎ zhuōbiān yìzhī dèng nuókāi , jiào tā zǒujìn , bǎn hòu yǒu liǎngtiáo duǎn mù guǐ , mùxiē liú zhe kě chāi de kǒu , yuánxiān nà piàn tiě zhěngpiàn jiā zài lǐtou , méiyǒu jié duǎn .
pairs.english: Song Yuan moved one stool beside the table away and called him closer; behind the board were two short wooden rails, the wedges leaving a removable opening, with the original iron piece clamped whole inside, not cut shorter.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远把桌边一只凳挪开，叫他走近，板后有两条短木轨，木楔留着可拆的口，原先那片铁整片夹在里头，没有截短。

pairs.target: lìng yípiàn réng zhuāng zài lìngyìzhī mù zuò lǐ , liǎngbiān gè yǒu xiǎo yā mù hé dǎng piàn , zhǎngxīn néng pèng de dìfāng dōu lù zhe , búbì gé zhe wòbǎ cāi .
pairs.english: The other piece was still mounted in another wooden seat; each side had small loading blocks and stops, and every place the palms could touch lay exposed, with no need to guess through a grip.
pairs.hanzi: 另一片仍装在另一只木座里，两边各有小压木和挡片，掌心能碰的地方都露着，不必隔着握把猜。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī shuō jīnrì zhǐ zài zhuōshàng shì , mù tuō bùnéng jièhuíqù , yě bù jiā rén yǔ rén zhījiān de zhuàngjī , sòng yuǎn tīng zhe , xiān zìjǐ fú le fú huázuò de dǐ .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey said today they would test only on the table: the wooden carriers could not be borrowed home, and no impacts between people would be added; listening, Song Yuan first steadied the sliding seat's base himself.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师说今日只在桌上试，木托不能借回去，也不加人与人之间的撞击，宋远听着，先自己扶了扶滑座的底。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxià kàn , bǎn wǎnghòuzǒu shí , huì xiān dài nà piàn tiě wān yìdiǎn , zǒu de zài shēn , mù dǎng biàn jiē zhù , búràng tā yìzhí wānxiàqù .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched to look; as the board moved backward it would first cause that iron piece to bend a little; if it traveled farther, the wooden stop then caught it, preventing it from continuing to bend.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下看，板往后走时，会先带那片铁弯一点，走得再深，木挡便接住，不让它一直弯下去。

pairs.target: tā wèn dǎng piàn jìrán zài , zìjǐ háiyào kàn shénme , sòng yuǎn yòng zhǐtou zài bǎn shàng qīngtuī yíxià , jiào tā kànkàn mù dǎng qiánmiàn yuánxiān háiyǒu duōshǎo lù .
pairs.english: He asked what he still had to watch if the stop was there; Song Yuan gave the board one gentle push with his finger and told him to look at how much travel originally remained before the wooden stop.
pairs.hanzi: 他问挡片既然在，自己还要看什么，宋远用指头在板上轻推一下，叫他看看木挡前面原先还有多少路。

pairs.target: bǎn tuì le yìdiǎn jiù tíng , yā mù de wèizhì yě gēnzhe biàn , tǎ wéi kàn míngbái , táitóu shí xiǎnxiē bǎ étóu kē zài zhuō yán , sòng yuǎn bǎshǒu diànguòqù , láibùjí xiào .
pairs.english: The board retreated a little and stopped, the loading block's position changing with it; Tavi understood, almost knocking his forehead on the table edge as he looked up; Song Yuan slipped his hand between, with no time to laugh.
pairs.hanzi: 板退了一点就停，压木的位置也跟着变，塔维看明白，抬头时险些把额头磕在桌沿，宋远把手垫过去，来不及笑。

pairs.target: tā zuò hǎo hòu xiān shì fàng shuāngshǒu , zuǒzhǎng yì tiē , mùbǎn biàn dòng le , wéi lǎoshī méi ràng tā jiè xìng , jiào tā xiān shuō zhè shì shuí tuī de .
pairs.english: After sitting down he first tried placing both hands; the instant his left palm touched, the board then moved; Instructor Vey did not let him borrow properties, asking him first to say who was pushing this.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐好后先试放双手，左掌一贴，木板便动了，维老师没让他借性，叫他先说这是谁推的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ , chóngxīn sōng jiān , shǒuzhǐ búzài sǐkòu mù biān , bǎn què hái huàng , sòng yuǎn kàn le kàn , zhuǎn dào tā zuǒbiān bǎ mù tuō yí jìn yìxiǎo jié .
pairs.english: Tavi said himself, relaxing his shoulders again and no longer clamping his fingers on the wood's edge, but the board still wobbled; Song Yuan looked, moved to his left and brought the carrier a short distance closer.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己，重新松肩，手指不再死扣木边，板却还晃，宋远看了看，转到他左边把木托移近一小截。

pairs.target: tā de gēbo búbì xuán de nàme yuǎn le , liǎngshǒu cáinéng zài mù tuō shàng qīngfàng , wéi lǎoshī chóngxīn liáng guò liǎngpiàn zhěng tiě , kàn kèxiàn , huànhuí tóngyàng de xiǎo zàihè , dǎng piàn yě xiàn zài qīngzài xià néng huīfù de fànwéi nèi .
pairs.english: His arms no longer had to reach so far unsupported, and only then could both hands rest lightly on the wooden carriers; Instructor Vey measured again the two whole iron pieces, checked the marks, restored the same small loads, and kept the stops within the range that allowed recovery under light load.
pairs.hanzi: 他的胳膊不必悬得那么远了，两手才能在木托上轻放，维老师重新量过两片整铁，看刻线，换回同样的小载荷，挡片也限在轻载下能恢复的范围内。

pairs.target: tāmen xiānchá bú jiè xìng shí de tuìràng , sòng yuǎn ànzhe huà hǎo de dìfāng màn tuī , tíngxià , chè lì , mùpiàn dōu huí le yuánwèi , yòu huàn tǎ wéi shuō yíbiàn .
pairs.english: They first checked the yielding without borrowing properties; Song Yuan pushed slowly at the marked place, stopped and removed the force, and the wooden indicators all returned to their original positions; then Tavi took a turn stating it once.
pairs.hanzi: 他们先查不借性时的退让，宋远按着画好的地方慢推，停下，撤力，木片都回了原位，又换塔维说一遍。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn xián tā shuō de xiàng bèishū , wéi lǎoshī què jiào sòng yuǎn zìjǐ yě shuō , bié dàihuìer yì zháojí , ná liàn guàn de jìn tì zhè zhāng zhuōzi zuòzhǔ .
pairs.english: Song Yuan complained he sounded like he was reciting a lesson; Instructor Vey, however, told Song Yuan to say it himself too, rather than get impatient later and let his practiced strength dictate what happened to this table.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远嫌他说得像背书，维老师却叫宋远自己也说，别待会儿一着急，拿练惯的劲替这张桌子做主。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn kàn le tā yìyǎn , dàodǐ shuō le bù jiālì , bù cuī tā dòngjiǎo , tǎ wéi zhèhuí méiyǒu xiào , zhǐ wèn ruò zìjǐ xiān jiàotíng , bàng shìbushì yě tíng .
pairs.english: Song Yuan glanced at her once and finally said he would not add force or hurry him into moving his feet; this time Tavi did not laugh, only asking whether the stick would stop too if he called a halt first.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远看了她一眼，到底说了不加力、不催他动脚，塔维这回没有笑，只问若自己先叫停，棒是不是也停。

pairs.target: jīnrì gēnběn méiyǒu bàng , sòng yuǎn bǎ kōngshǒu gěi tā kàn , shuō shǒu yě tíng , méi děng tā zhuīwèn , yòu shuō tíng zì ruò méi tīng qīng , zìjǐ yě děi xiān tíng .
pairs.english: There was no stick at all today; Song Yuan showed him his empty hand and said the hand stopped too; without waiting for him to ask further, he also said that if he did not hear halt clearly, he himself must stop first anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 今日根本没有棒，宋远把空手给他看，说手也停，没等他追问，又说停字若没听清，自己也得先停。

pairs.target: xiē guò yíhuìer , tǎ wéi jiāng liǎng zhǎng fàng huí lùchū de tiěmiàn , qīngqīng jiē qǐ shúxī de chābié , zuǒbiān duōyìdiǎn tuìràng , yòubiān shǎo yìdiǎn , méi zhuīqiú gèng dà de kèxiàn .
pairs.english: After resting a while, Tavi put both palms back on the exposed iron surfaces, gently establishing the familiar difference: a little more yielding on the left, a little less on the right, without chasing larger readings on the marks.
pairs.hanzi: 歇过一会儿，塔维将两掌放回露出的铁面，轻轻接起熟悉的差别，左边多一点退让，右边少一点，没追求更大的刻线。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn děng tā diǎntóu , cái zhào fāngcái de wèizhì màn tuī mùbǎn , bǎn xiàng hòu duō zǒu le yìdiǎn , tǎ wéi chàdiǎn gēnzhe táijiān , yǎnjīng yíxià luòdào mù dǎng shàng .
pairs.english: Song Yuan waited for his nod before slowly pushing the board at the earlier spot; the board traveled a little farther backward, Tavi almost raised his shoulder with it, and his eyes immediately went to the wooden stop.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远等他点头，才照方才的位置慢推木板，板向后多走了一点，塔维差点跟着抬肩，眼睛一下落到木挡上。

pairs.target: mùbǎn méi pèngdào mù dǎng , yòubiān nà yìxiǎo chù yě hái zài , tā bǎ zhè jù shuōchū , sòng yuǎn yǐ tíngzhù , shǒu liúzài bǎn shàng , méiyǒu zài duō tuī .
pairs.english: The board had not touched the stop, and that small sensation on the right still remained too; he said this, and Song Yuan had already halted, leaving his hand on the board without pushing any more.
pairs.hanzi: 木板没碰到木挡，右边那一小处也还在，他把这句说出，宋远已停住，手留在板上，没有再多推。

pairs.target: shuāngshǒu réng tiēzhe , tǎ wéi xiān shōuhuí biànhuà , wéi lǎoshī chá liǎngbiān de fǎnyìng , sòng yuǎn chè qù shǒushàng de qīngyā , zài chá yícì , cái ràng tā lí shǒu , xièxià xiǎo zàihè .
pairs.english: With both hands still touching, Tavi first canceled the change; Instructor Vey checked both sides' responses, Song Yuan removed his hand's gentle pressure, and she checked once again before letting him lift his hands and remove the small loads.
pairs.hanzi: 双手仍贴着，塔维先收回变化，维老师查两边的反应，宋远撤去手上的轻压，再查一次，才让他离手、卸下小载荷。

pairs.target: mùbǎn réng shì yuánxiān de mùbǎn , méiyǒu bǎ sòng yuǎn tuīhuíqù , yě méiyǒu dǎng xià yícì kuài dǎ , tǎ wéi què rěnbúzhù yòu kàn le yìyǎn tā duō zǒuguò de nà diǎn dìfāng .
pairs.english: The board was still the original board; it had not made Song Yuan move back or blocked one fast strike, but Tavi could not resist looking once more at the little extra distance it had traveled.
pairs.hanzi: 木板仍是原先的木板，没有把宋远推回去，也没有挡下一次快打，塔维却忍不住又看了一眼它多走过的那点地方。

pairs.target: tā wèn zhè shìbushì yǐjīng suàn fàngjìn dùn lǐ le , wéi lǎoshī shuō suàn huàn le mù tuō de yícì qīngzài shìyàn , sòng yuǎn shuō wǎnghòu názàishǒushàng , yòu shì biéde yìhuí .
pairs.english: He asked whether this already counted as putting it inside a shield; Instructor Vey said it counted as one light-load trial with a changed carrier; Song Yuan said holding it in the hands later would be a different turn again.
pairs.hanzi: 他问这是不是已经算放进盾里了，维老师说算换了木托的一次轻载试验，宋远说往后拿在手上，又是别的一回。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǒudiǎn shīwàng , guò le yízhèn yòu wèn , fāngcái ruò yòubiān xiān dàn , zuǒbiān hái méi dào mù dǎng , zìjǐ gāibugāi xiān tíng , sòng yuǎn shuō gāi , búyòng děng mùtou tì tā hǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi was a little disappointed, then after a while asked about the earlier trial: if the right side faded first and the left had not reached the stop, should he himself halt first; Song Yuan said yes, without waiting for the wood to call out on his behalf.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维有点失望，过了一阵又问，方才若右边先淡，左边还没到木挡，自己该不该先停，宋远说该，不用等木头替他喊。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhè yíjù xiě jìn cè lǐ , yòushǒu xiě de màn , què méiyǒu mópò zhǎngxīn , wéi lǎoshī shōuzǒu liǎngpiàn tiě , ràng nà duì kōng mù tuō liúzài zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: He wrote that sentence in his notebook, slowly with his right hand but without chafing his palm open; Instructor Vey took the two iron pieces away, letting the pair of empty wooden carriers remain on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 他把这一句写进册里，右手写得慢，却没有磨破掌心，维老师收走两片铁，让那对空木托留在桌上。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn wèn tā hái xiǎng buxiǎng zài kàn yìhuí , tǎ wéi shuō xiǎng , sòng yuǎn zhèng shēnshǒu qù ná mù tuō , wéi lǎoshī xiān kàn guòlái , tā biàn bǎshǒu guǎi dào shuǐhú shàng , shuō wèn de shì tú .
pairs.english: Song Yuan asked if he still wanted another look; Tavi said yes, and Song Yuan was reaching for the carrier when Instructor Vey looked over first; he then diverted his hand to the water jug and said he had meant the drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远问他还想不想再看一回，塔维说想，宋远正伸手去拿木托，维老师先看过来，他便把手拐到水壶上，说问的是图。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái xiào , hēshuǐ shí xiǎngqǐ shānlù shang nàgēn shǐ , xiào méi quánsàn , tā yě méiyǒu wèile zhèngmíng búpà , jiào rén bǎ mùbǎn jǔ dào zìjǐ miànqián .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi laugh; drinking water he remembered that arrow on the mountain road, but the smile did not entirely fade; nor did he ask anyone to raise the board before him just to prove he was not afraid.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才笑，喝水时想起山路上那根矢，笑没全散，他也没有为了证明不怕，叫人把木板举到自己面前。

pairs.target: zǒuchū liànxí jiān qián , tā huítóu wèn xiàhuí hái xiānchá pǔtōng de fǎnyìng ma , wéi lǎoshī shuō shì , tā biàn bǎ cèzi fān dào kòngbáiyè , gěi xià yìhuí liú le dìfāng .
pairs.english: Before leaving the practice room, he turned back to ask whether next time they would still check ordinary responses first; Instructor Vey said yes, and he turned his notebook to a blank page, leaving room for the next session.
pairs.hanzi: 走出练习间前，他回头问下回还先查普通的反应吗，维老师说是，他便把册子翻到空白页，给下一回留了地方。
